runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Existing LIVE items are never removed merely because a discovery run does not rediscover them.
runSummary.note: Real 14.9.2026 11:40 sweep across 12 source families: Profesia, direct company careers/public ATS, LinkedIn public jobs indexing, Worki, Kariera/Zoznam, Brigada.sk, Pretlak, StartupJobs, WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and publicly indexed Facebook groups. Strongest fresh evidence is a newer Trenujeme Bratislava e-commerce assistant posting (Profesia O5349827 / public mirrors) with part-time or IČO form, 60–120 h/month, e-shop orders, customer support, complaints and stock. Because the LIVE feed already contains the same title+company under stable id profesia-trenujeme-5335564, this is treated as a re-verification/refresh signal rather than a duplicate promotion. Hemmersbach Job-Id 19971 and IKEA Job ID 355434 remain promotion-ready. Facebook produced 0 verified direct-post hits. No LIVE deletion was performed.

developmentChanges.title: Same-title/company refresh dedupe
developmentChanges.reason: When a company republishes the same role under a new board ID, keep the existing stable LIVE ID and refresh evidence/fields instead of creating a duplicate. This prevents feed inflation while preserving recency.

developmentChanges.title: Freelance effective-pay floor
developmentChanges.reason: Reject or sharply down-rank remote freelance hits whose fixed budget becomes uneconomic after realistic task hours, platform fee and communication overhead, even when the functional match is excellent.
